comment: Read from the source at tag v2.1.14 (commit 75e5f70), which is the installed build. The mute button and the ratio knob of a row share one centre: the button (a CKD6 at 28px scaled to 0.85) sits inside the knob (36px scaled to 1.085), so a click on the dark inner circle reaches the button and a click on the ringed outer edge reaches the knob. Help.cpp resolves overlapping controls by the smaller box, so both are reachable and both are tagged. The panel prints no label on the knob at all; it is called Ratio in the maker's tooltip and on the maker's page, and the lines use that name. Ratio values map through a 65-entry list, /32 at -32 through Immediate at 0 to X32 at +32.
